# Component Shared Reference

This document is owned by component C1 and should be visible to every
deliverable under C1 (C1P1 and C1P2 alike), because reference context
accumulates up the tree.

It talks about public transport information systems, GTFS feeds, and
real-time vehicle positions, so that a query for "public transport
information" run from either C1P1 or C1P2 can find it.
